edge_cases: 3x3 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 3 K-tiles (bigger amortization than the 64x64/2x2 sibling)
HMX accumulator persists across K-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
input range chosen so |requant| < 2048 (12-bit field exact, no saturation)
n=96 = 3/4 HVX vector -> HVX baseline exercises the vsetq tail-mask path
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy

SIZING NOTE: authored+verified bit-exact at 128x128/4x4 first, but that shape's O(n^3) scalar reference pushed sim wall time to ~58s (over the ~40s budget); 96x96/3x3 is the largest grid in-budget (~31s) while still amortizing more than the 64x64 sibling
name: i8_matmul_hmx_96x96
